title: Bài 2: Cuộc Đời Đa-vít
subtitle: The Life of David — 1 Samuel 16-17; Psalm 51 · Ngữ pháp: Past perfect (had + past participle); past perfect vs past simple in narrative
grammar_topic: Past perfect (had + past participle); past perfect vs past simple in narrative
objectives: Học và thực hành: Past perfect (had + past participle); past perfect vs past simple in narrative.
Luyện phát âm: Connected speech: linking /r/ and /w/.
Đọc và hiểu đoạn Kinh Thánh 1 Samuel 16-17; Psalm 51.

vocabulary.ex: David was a shepherd before he became king.
Samuel anointed David as the new king of Israel.
David fought Goliath with only a sling and five stones.
Goliath was a giant, almost three metres tall.
David did not wear Saul's heavy armour.
The battle belonged to the Lord.
David showed great courage before Goliath.
God chose a humble shepherd boy to be king.
David repented of his sin and prayed to God.
God is full of mercy and forgives all who repent.
Create in me a clean heart, O God.
Psalm 51 is David's prayer of repentance.
David betrayed Uriah by taking his wife.
God forgives those who confess their sins.
David knew that his sin had hurt God and others.
David fought Goliath by faith in the Lord.
God gave David a great victory over Goliath.
David became the king of God's kingdom, Israel.
The prophet Samuel anointed David.
David protected his father's flock from lions and bears.
David trusted God more than his own strength.
David honoured the Lord in all his victories.

grammar.title: Past perfect (had + past participle); past perfect vs past simple in narrative
grammar.explain: Phần Grammar Blueprint đầy đủ (giải thích chi tiết và ví dụ) nằm trong file PDF bài học.

listening_questions.q: 1. True or False: David was the oldest of Jesse's sons.
listening_questions.a: False. David was the youngest of eight sons.

listening_questions.q: 2. True or False: Samuel had already looked at David's seven older brothers before God chose David.
3. How long had Goliath shouted his challenge before David fought him?
4. What did David use to defeat Goliath?
listening_questions.a: A sling and one smooth stone.

listening_questions.q: 5. What did David pray in Psalm 51?
listening_questions.a: "Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me."

exercises.title: Exercise 1: Past Perfect or Past Simple?
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct verb form. Remember: the past perfect (had + past participle) describes the EARLIER of two past actions.

exercises.title: Exercise 2: Complete the Story — Past Perfect and Past Simple
exercises.instruction: Put each verb in brackets into the past perfect (had + past participle) or the past simple.

exercises.title: Exercise 3: Vocabulary Matching
exercises.instruction: Match each word with its correct definition.

exercises.title: Exercise 4: Connected Speech — Linking /r/ and /w/
exercises.instruction: In connected speech, a word ending in /r/ or /w/ links smoothly to the next word beginning with a vowel. Read each phrase aloud as ONE smooth sound, without a pause. Then underline the linking sound.

exercises.title: Exercise 5: Ministry Translation Lab (Vietnamese to English)
exercises.instruction: Translate into natural English. Use the past perfect where the Vietnamese shows one past action happened before another.

exercises.title: Exercise 6: Guided Ministry Writing (80-100 words)
exercises.instruction: Retell the story of David and Goliath in your own words (80-100 words). Use the past perfect at least THREE times, and use at least 4 target words (shepherd, giant, sling, courage, faith, victory).

written.q: 1. By the time David fought Goliath, he __________ (already / save) his sheep from a lion and a bear.
2. Samuel __________ (anoint) David after Jesse __________ (present) his seven older sons.

written.a: did not wear; had never tried
written.q: 3. David __________ (not wear) Saul's armour because he __________ (never / try) it in battle before.

written.a: "Before David became king, he had looked after his father's sheep for many years."
written.q: 4. Translate: Trước khi Đa-vít trở thành vua, ông đã chăn chiên cho cha mình nhiều năm.

written.a: "David repented because he knew that only God could give him a clean heart."
written.q: 5. Translate: Đa-vít đã ăn năn vì ông biết rằng chỉ Đức Chúa Trời mới có thể ban cho ông một tấm lòng trong sạch.

listening.a: Because God looks at the heart, not at outward appearance (1 Sam 16:7); David had a humble, faithful heart.
listening.q: 1. Why did God choose David, the youngest son, and not one of his older brothers?
2. What two animals had David already saved his sheep from before he faced Goliath?

listening.a: Not because David never sinned, but because he repented and trusted in God's mercy.
listening.q: 3. In the dialogue, what does the Friend learn about why David was called 'a man after God's own heart'?

homework.memory_verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me. — Psalm 51:10 (ESV)
homework.memory_verse_vi: Đức Chúa Trời ôi, xin dựng nên trong con một lòng trong sạch, và làm mới lại trong con một thần linh ngay thẳng. — Thi Thiên 51:10
